notes.text:
This update for glib2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-4373: integer overflow in the `g_string_insert_unichar()` function can lead to buffer underwrite and memory
  corruption (bsc#1242844).

notes.text: A flaw was found in GLib, which is vulnerable to an integer overflow in the g_string_insert_unichar() function. When the position at which to insert the character is large, the position will overflow, leading to a buffer underwrite.
notes.title: CVE description
